name: openssl
description: OpenSSL is an open source project that provides a robust, commercial-grade, and full-featured toolkit for the Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) protocols. It is also a general-purpose cryptography library.

fips.description: Build OpenSSL with FIPS support. See https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/tree/master/ports/openssl#fips

weak-ssl-ciphers.description: Build support for *weak* encryption ciphers. These should only be enabled for backward compatibility.
